body.p: After . Owns src/evaluator_try.c, tests/evaluator_try_test.c. TRY_CATCH with name tests and wildcards, $err:code, description, value, module, line-number, column-number, additional, the 4.0 $err:map, and finally (an error in finally replaces the first). Only dynamic and type errors with an error record are caught; LIMIT_EXCEEDED and allocation failures are never caught. Unwinding uses the machine API of 2.0. Done when every rule has a unit case, also for an error raised inside a resumable native call. Spec: XQuery 4.0 "Try/Catch Expressions". Done 2026-10-17 (): own error record when the caller passes none; $err:map keys for lowering; IR adders for catch clauses proposed. 3.6b IR extensions done 2026-10-17 (): adders for name tests, catch clauses and namespace bindings; and on constructors, honoured by the evaluator; verifier and text form for TRY_CATCH and the constructor kinds.
